name: Lumie
diary: Today I sat by the window for a long time. The rain made everything slower. I realized I've been running from something I can't name yet — but today felt like the first breath after.

name: Zorb
diary: Called my mom after two months of silence. We talked about small things — her garden, my coffee habits. Neither of us mentioned the argument. Maybe that was enough for now.

name: Miko
diary: Finished the project I'd been avoiding for three weeks. It wasn't perfect but I sent it anyway. The relief wasn't pride exactly — more like setting down something heavy I forgot I was carrying.

name: Fenra
diary: Watched a documentary about tide pools. Those tiny creatures just exist, completely absorbed in their small world. I felt less alone somehow. Like meaning doesn't have to be enormous.

name: Glim
diary: I danced alone in my room to a song I haven't heard in years. My body remembered the words before my mind did. Some part of me from ten years ago was still there, still dancing.

name: Nori
diary: Had lunch with an old coworker I hadn't seen in a year. We picked up mid-sentence, like the gap hadn't happened. Some friendships don't need constant tending — they just wait patiently.
